evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically from ~6 ppm to 51.5 ppm through growth, far above purge-stabilized baseline
Tube pressure creeping 2.98 -> 3.44 Torr at constant Ar setpoint/flow
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so pressure rise is not flow-driven
Temperature control nominal at 750 °C, heater power steady ~43%

args.missing_evidence: A flow-off/pump-down or Ar step test to distinguish air in-leak (O2 persists, pressure rise independent of flow) from partial exhaust restriction; leak-check of end-cap seals
